decision: A second pass said the trail was written after the fact and that Stripe was never called. That is right. The session shape and the 409 rule are unit-tested. The webhook force-cancel path has not run against Stripe. A member who already turned auto-renew off can start another subscription while the current term is still active, which is what the spec asked and can overlap two subscriptions. Survey, roster CSV, and privacy copy shipped in the same PR.
why: The reviewer should not treat tests green as a live Stripe run.

decision: Stopped sending cancel_at_period_end on Checkout subscription_data
why: This Stripe SDK type for Checkout subscription_data has no such field. An unknown parameter would fail session create. The webhook already updates the subscription after payment.
